bio: This inviting restaurant is run by Christoph Forthuber, who brings experience from prestigious kitchens to the table. Since spring 2025, he has been serving up flavoursome seasonal dishes crafted from locally sourced ingredients. Diners can choose between two set menus – one hearty, one light – or go à la carte. The wallet-friendly lunch deal is a hit. Diners are treated to friendly and adept service in a cosy setting – the long table in front of the decorative wine cabinet is ideal for larger parties. In summer, tables are set up in the shade of trees in the lovely garden, where there is also a gazebo for special occasions or additional needs. Guestrooms are available nearby....
